entry.label: Principia Cybernetica Project
entry.description: The project history attributes the early project to Turchin and Joslyn and reports Heylighen joining the editorial board in 1990. Its overview describes a board, contributors, publications, meetings, and electronic lists. These are dated project self-reports.
entry.canonical_definition: A collaborative project seeking to develop a cybernetic and evolutionary philosophy with computer support.
